mission.title: Laying the Groundwork
mission.description: Attack the Merovingian's holdings and hunt down his lieutenants.

phase.briefing:
The pace of events is picking up, {player}. We are beginning to make real progress in our efforts to remove the Merovingian's presence from the Matrix.
Your job today is to apply pressure. With enough of his assets under attack, he will lose... focus; his pathetic empire will begin to crumble around him.
Proceed to the location indicated, and deal with any Exiles present.

done.say: That's the last hostile on site.

phase.briefing: Well done. I am now sending you to the location of one of the Merovingian's lieutenants, Fanale. Terminate him.

enter.say: My readings show Fanale in here, with some security.

done.say: I'm reading his signal... plus some sort of fluctuation... get through that next door, now!
Dammit! He's gone... and I suppose you know what kind of signals I'm getting, too. The Effectuator.

phase.briefing:
The escape of Fanale certainly is disappointing. However, our goals proceed as scheduled. Continue your attacks against the Merovingian's holdings.
At the location indicated, you will find a certain Ashbrook. She is one of the Merovingian's security captains. Her deletion would prove very... detrimental to the Merovingian's operations.

enter.say: Looks like plenty of bad guys in here.

done.say: Gone! The entire place is empty! This is such... aw, just get out of there.

mission.finish: It would appear that the Effectuator's "talents" are becoming a bit too... inconvenient. Would you not agree, {player}?
